plans.name: Go
plans.included: Business SMS / MMS 50 per user per month; AI transcription 10 conversations per user per month; XBert, 10 free interactions

plans.name: Business
plans.included: Toll-free 1 + 2,000 min; Business SMS / MMS 500 per user per month; AI transcription 200 conversations per user per month; XBert, 10 free interactions

plans.name: CX
plans.included: Toll-free 3 + 10,000 min; Business SMS / MMS Unlimited; AI transcription Unlimited; XBert, 10 free interactions

plans.name: AI Front Office
plans.included: Up to 1,000 conversations a month; Team access Up to 5; AI Agents interactions 100 included

plans.name: AI Growth
plans.included: Over 1,000 conversations a month; Team access Up to 30 employees; AI Agents interactions 1000 included
plans.overage: Additional employees are $100 per user per month.

notes: The Go, Business and CX prices are annual-billing rates. Line 908 says: "Annual pricing reflects per-user, per-month rates with annual billing. Monthly billing rates are higher." The page doesn't list monthly-billing prices for these plans. The Super Pack prices come in pairs: the lower price is the annual rate and the higher one is marked "Billed monthly" (AI Super Pack $15, "Save 33%"; Messaging Super Pack $25, "Save 20%"). The CX Super Pack has no listed price ("Contact us"), only works with CX plans, and isn't recorded as a plan. Line 1 has a Black Friday promo: "3 months FREE on every call, text, chat, and the AI that runs them." The page mentions no setup fee. Professional services are listed as an "Add-on" with no price. International calling is charged at "Per-minute rates" with no figures given. Line 646 says XBert overage is $0.99 per interaction with Premium or Premium+.

free_trial.text: Try XBert free with every plan.
